subject: Urdu

outcomes.text: Follow and respond to events, stories, speeches and explanations heard from different sources.
Judge what is heard for ethical, economic, social and cultural points, and weigh it with reasons.
Hold a reasoned conversation in daily life using correct pronunciation and tone.
Present opinions on a topic as a short speech with clear wording and delivery.
Read prose or verse with understanding and answer direct, indirect and multi-part questions.
Give an opinion on a passage read, using references and reasons.
Read a poem, explain its verses and give a personal view on it.
Read a text and present how its ideas, views and attitudes relate to one another.
Tell the matla from the maqta in a ghazal and see how they differ.
Proofread and edit writing, checking word spelling and use.
Write sentences of the class level, with idioms, proverbs and phrases (simple, then compound and complex).
Explain the lines of a poem or ghazal, covering the poet's view, style and use of poetic devices.
Read a poem or prose piece and write a summary of its main points.
Write the central idea of a poem or prose piece while keeping the writer's or poet's view in mind.
Translate passages from English to Urdu, keeping the meaning and purpose.
Write formal and informal letters and emails suited to the occasion.
Fill in forms such as admission, ATM card, utility and service forms.
Tell autobiography, travelogue and memo writing apart and write an information report.
Understand formal and informal writing such as applications, news, reports and reviews, then critique it.
Summarise and explain chosen passages.
Write a speech of at least 250 words on a topic with verses and references.
Understand and critique or review a literary work, prose or poetry, using given guidance.

units.title: Skill E: Grammar and Language (قواعد / زبان شناسی)

outcomes.text: Understand gender and number changes and use them in speech and writing.
Make new words with prefixes and suffixes and use them correctly.
Find pairs of opposite-meaning words and use them in writing.
Spot word combinations (idiomatic phrases) and use them in writing, seeing why they matter.
Tell proverbs from idioms and use them in writing and speech.
Identify nouns, verbs and particles in sentences, including exclamation, conjunction and other particles.
Identify complete and incomplete phrases, and the nominal and verbal sentence with its subject and predicate.
Correct wrongly built sentences, tenses and wrongly used words.
Pronounce words correctly and use diacritics to read and write them right.
Tell poems apart by subject: hamd, naat, national poem, qasida, prayer, elegy and others.
Tell poems apart by form: ghazal, mukhammas and musaddas.
Name the parts of a ghazal or poem: matla, maqta, verse, couplet, qafia, radif and band.
Recognise the merits of a poem and the devices of rhetoric: simile and metaphor, then allusion and figurative usage.

Find synonyms and use them properly in writing.
Recognise look-alike and sound-alike words and use them in writing and speech.
Match words with similar meanings and use them in sentences.
Spot word combinations (idiomatic phrases) and use them in writing, seeing why they matter.
Tell proverbs from idioms and use them in writing and speech.
Identify punctuation marks and use them correctly in writing.
Identify complete and incomplete phrases, and the nominal and verbal sentence with its subject and predicate.
